name: I Scream
summary: I Scream is a thrilling VR horror experience where you must rescue a small monkey named Milo from the clutches of the sinister I Scream Man. Trapped in a chilling nightmare, you'll explore three unique maps: the eerie Cafeteria, the abandoned Playground, and the dark, desolate Parking Place. Each location holds secrets, puzzles, and dangers as you fight to survive and uncover the truth behind the I Scream Man. Outsmart him, stay quiet, and don’t let Milo down.
